fix_plan.title: Apply existing rate limiting to all API routes
fix_plan.fix_action: rate-limit.ts already has checkRateLimit(), getClientIp(), and RATE_LIMITS presets (auth: 10/min, api: 60/min, sensitive: 20/min, webhook: 100/min). Import and apply at the top of each route handler: check rate limit → return 429 if exceeded. Priority routes: auth/register (use 'auth' preset), scan (use 'sensitive' preset), tenders/analyze (use 'sensitive' preset), all organization CRUD (use 'api' preset).

fix_plan.pattern: import { checkRateLimit, getClientIp, RATE_LIMITS } from '@/lib/rate-limit'; const ip = getClientIp(request); const rl = checkRateLimit(ip, RATE_LIMITS.auth); if (!rl.allowed) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Too many requests' }, { status: 429 });
